skill.name: meme-factory
skill.description: Generate meme image URLs and Markdown-ready meme content with memegen.link templates, text encoding guidance, examples, and a Python helper.
skill.summary: Create image and text memes for technical communication using memegen.link.
skill.author: softaworks

security_audit.summary: No prompt-injection language or hidden malicious intent was found in the reviewed files. The static command findings are Markdown backticks and examples, while the network findings are documented memegen.link URLs for the stated purpose. Users should still avoid placing sensitive information in public meme captions or custom background URLs.

remediation.suggestion: Add a clear note that captions and custom background URLs may be sent to memegen.link and should not contain secrets.
Replace profane sample copypasta in references/markdown-memes-guide.md with a neutral example for professional audiences.

content.value_statement: Teams often need quick visual humor without opening design tools. This skill builds meme URLs, Markdown embeds, and text meme formats from a prompt.
actual_capabilities: Creates memegen.link URLs for named meme templates and captions.
Formats spaces, punctuation, and line breaks for meme URL paths.
Suggests templates for common contexts such as reviews, deployments, and debugging.
Supports size, layout, font, image format, and custom background options.
Provides Markdown examples for embedding generated meme images.
Includes a Python helper for URL generation and template suggestions.
limitations: Generated image URLs depend on the public memegen.link service.
Caption text appears in the generated URL and may be visible to external services.
The helper script creates URLs and Markdown, not downloaded image files.
Very long captions can become unreadable on small meme templates.

use_cases.title: Make Code Reviews More Visual
use_cases.description: Add visual context to code review comments, bug discussions, or deployment notes.

use_cases.title: Draft Technical Social Posts
use_cases.description: Create quick humorous visuals for technical announcements without dedicated design software.

use_cases.title: Add Memes to Markdown Content
use_cases.description: Mix image memes and text meme formats into Markdown blog posts or documentation.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Meme
prompt_templates.prompt: Use meme-factory to create a simple meme about bugs appearing everywhere. Pick a suitable template and keep each caption short.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Two Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Drake-style comparison meme about manual testing versus automated testing. Return the image link and a short alt text.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Release Post Meme
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a social media sized meme for a successful production deployment. Use concise captions and include a Markdown embed suggestion.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Markdown Meme Section
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a short Markdown section that combines one text meme format with one memegen.link image meme about documentation debt.

output_examples.input: Create a meme about bugs everywhere.
output_examples.output: A Buzz Lightyear style meme with top caption "bugs" and bottom caption "bugs everywhere", plus a Markdown-ready image reference.

output_examples.input: Compare manual testing and automated testing.
output_examples.output: A comparison meme that rejects manual testing and favors automated testing, with concise alt text for sharing.

output_examples.input: Make a Markdown meme section about deployment anxiety.
output_examples.output: A short section with a greentext-style setup, one generated image meme, and a closing punchline.

best_practices: Keep captions short so the image stays readable.
Choose a template that matches the message, not only a popular template.
Do not include secrets, customer data, or private URLs in meme text.
anti_patterns: Do not send confidential incident details to public meme URLs.
Do not use long paragraphs as image captions.
Do not use custom background URLs that expose private screenshots.

faq.question: Does this skill call an external service?
faq.answer: It creates memegen.link URLs and may ask you to open or test them. Treat captions as data sent to that service.

faq.question: Does it require an API key?
faq.answer: No. The documentation describes the public memegen.link API, which does not require an API key.

faq.question: Can it create Markdown embeds?
faq.answer: Yes. It can return a meme description, an image URL, and Markdown-ready embedding guidance.

faq.question: Can it choose a template for me?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes guidance for matching templates to contexts such as comparisons, success, uncertainty, and incidents.

faq.question: Can it generate text-only memes?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes Markdown patterns for greentext, chat logs, ASCII art, copypasta, and similar formats.

faq.question: What should I avoid sharing?
faq.answer: Avoid secrets, private screenshots, unreleased product details, and sensitive incident information.
